intro.title: Deploy a Seed site on CapRover
intro.subtitle: Self-host a Seed Hypermedia site from one one-click app template

beats.apps: Start on the CapRover Apps page
beats.template: Open >> TEMPLATE << for a custom one-click app
beats.app-name: Name the app — its services are prefixed with it
beats.domain: Set site.example.com as the site domain
beats.secret: CapRover generates the registration secret — keep it private
beats.deploy: Deploy proxy, daemon, web and updater
beats.wait: Wait until every Seed service is running
beats.instructions: The final steps include your private registration link
beats.apps-list: Four apps — Shepherd updates the daemon and web images
beats.force-https: Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS
beats.site: Your site is live — register it from Seed desktop
